stages.name: Dev-kit bench
stages.gate: average current measured with a power profiler meets the budget with 2x margin; memory size and battery capacity chosen from the measurement

stages.name: Works-like / looks-like
stages.gate: printed enclosure with catalogue cell fits the stack-up; users wear it for a week

stages.name: EVT-0 layout, fab, bring-up
stages.gate: all rails up, radio links, sensors read, current within 20% of bench

stages.name: EVT-1 board revision
stages.gate: antenna tuned in the real enclosure on a body; IPX7 pre-test passed

stages.name: Custom cell RFQ and samples
stages.gate: cell samples meet rated minimum capacity, swelling allowance and thickness tolerance

stages.name: Tooling T1 + iterations
stages.gate: T1 parts within drawing tolerances; cosmetic spec agreed

stages.name: DVT build (50-100 units)
stages.gate: drop, ESD, IP, thermal and life tests passed; pre-scan passed

stages.name: UN 38.3 of production cell
stages.gate: UN 38.3 report and test summary issued

stages.name: Radio and safety certification
stages.gate: certificates for every launch market; Bluetooth SIG listing

long_lead.item: LED driver IC (26 wk factory lead)
